{{Quote|We just got a panic call from the Sif'kric system. General Bel Iblis talked to them for maybe five minutes, and suddenly we're getting ready to fly.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Perris]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
The '''Sif'kric system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained the [[Sif'krie]] homeworld, [[Sif'kric]], as well as the homeworld of the [[Frezh]]lix. The inner [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was home to the commercially important [[pommwomm]] plants.<ref name="SotP" />

==History==
{{Quote|My father-in-law's got some interests here. Ten to one it's the Frezhlix; they've been feuding with the Sif'kries ever since we chased the Empire out of the area.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
The system was [[Blockade of Sif'kric|blockaded]] by the Frezhlix during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]]. The Frezhlix justification was the Sif'krie's opposition to the [[Drashtine Initiative]] in their [[sector assembly]], demanding that the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] pay reparations for the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. Up to 20% of their yearly pommwom production was at risk of being wiped out but the blockade was broken by the intervention of [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="SotP" />
